get_organic_config: get the default FermiNet config for running organic molecule simulations
configure_organic_molecule: configure a ConfigDict with molecule geometry and electron counts for bicyclobutane or cyclobutadiene
lookup_molecule_geometry: lookup atomic coordinates from the systems dictionary for bicyclobutane butadiene or cyclobutadiene geometries
set_electrons_for_molecule: set electron counts to 15 alpha 15 beta for butadiene or 14 alpha 14 beta for cyclobutadiene
validate_molecule_name: validate that a molecule name exists in the systems dictionary before building the molecule
